system_architecture_profile.core_design_philosophy: Decoupled Data Infrastructure. Pure JSON APIs. Presentational state handled exclusively by the frontend client view layer.

active_minion_matrix.CORE_PY: Python Backend Engine Specialist (Trace logging and safety try/except wrapping)

active_minion_matrix.DB_SQL: PostgreSQL & Schema Migration Specialist (ORM queries, zero raw SQL)
active_minion_matrix.SYS_GIT: Git Security Partition & Cloud Backup Specialist (Asynchronous background threads)

purgatory_engine_guardrails: Never write frontend HTML template code blocks inside your Django backend files.
Never troubleshoot file path parameters or API connection routes inside a web browser. Use python manage.py test.
Always offload network-bound operating system commands to a detached asynchronous background thread using threading.Thread(daemon=True).
Maintain a strict One-Task-Per-Session boundary layer. Micro-sweep chat context arrays frequently to stay under the Groq free-tier token ceiling.
